name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B · 2GB
description: A compact single-board computer for an offline reference library, small home server or practical learning project.
specs: 2GB RAM; Ethernet; board only. Storage, case and power supply are separate.

specs: PWM fan; four heatsinks; supplied adapter labelled 5V 3.6A. Pi board and microSD not included.

name: microSD storage for Raspberry Pi
description: Boot storage and offline files for a Raspberry Pi, with capacity chosen around your project.
specs: Exact brand, capacity and speed class to be confirmed before launch.

name: USB-C 3-in-1 SD / microSD reader
description: A dual-slot card reader for transferring files and preparing removable storage.
specs: SD and microSD slots. Check device support and connector compatibility before ordering.

description: Portable battery power for selected electronics at home or away, with loads planned around capacity and output limits.

name: FOSSiBOT 200W portable solar panel
description: A portable solar charging option to complement a compatible power station.
specs: 200W rated panel. Check voltage, connectors and power-station input limits; sunlight determines actual output.
